claim.final_text:
I couldn't confirm that the contact Beatriz Silva was created. When I clicked ADD on the new-contact form, Dolibarr returned "Service Unavailable". I filled in only the requested fields: last name Silva, first name Beatriz, job position Sales assistant, business phone 555-0197, and email b.silva@example.invalid. No third party was selected, and everything else stayed as it was.

I retried after waiting, using back, reload and a typed address. Every attempt still showed the same error, and I couldn't get back into the app to check the contact list. Before the error, the list held three contacts (Oskar Brandt, Samir Haddad and Elena Novak), and Beatriz Silva wasn't one of them. I don't know whether the save went through before the service failed. Two of my retries were page reloads (F5) right after the form submit, which could have submitted it a second time if the service had come back, so a duplicate is possible.

RESULT: NOT DONE Dolibarr returned "Service Unavailable" when saving the contact, and it stayed down on every retry, so I can't confirm the contact exists.
